title.ro: Trecerea la nivel cu calea ferata

fapta.en: Stopping or parking where prohibited by a sign or marking.
fapta.ro: Oprirea sau stationarea in locuri interzise prin indicator sau marcaj.

fapta.en: Driving without wearing the seat belt.
fapta.ro: Circulatia fara a purta centura de siguranta.

fapta.en: Exceeding the speed limit by 10-20 km/h.
fapta.ro: Depasirea vitezei maxime admise cu 10-20 km/h.

fapta.en: Using a hand-held mobile phone while driving.
fapta.ro: Folosirea telefonului mobil tinut in mana in timpul conducerii.

fapta.en: Exceeding the speed limit by 21-30 km/h.
fapta.ro: Depasirea vitezei maxime admise cu 21-30 km/h.

fapta.en: Failing to give way to pedestrians on a marked crossing.
fapta.ro: Neacordarea prioritatii pietonilor aflati pe trecerea semnalizata.

fapta.en: Exceeding the speed limit by 31-40 km/h.
fapta.ro: Depasirea vitezei maxime admise cu 31-40 km/h.

fapta.en: Driving on the opposite direction lane where the road is so marked.
fapta.ro: Circulatia pe sens opus, unde drumul este semnalizat corespunzator.

fapta.en: Exceeding the speed limit by more than 50 km/h.
fapta.ro: Depasirea vitezei maxime admise cu peste 50 km/h.

fapta.en: Driving under the influence of alcohol or psychoactive substances.
fapta.ro: Conducerea sub influenta bauturilor alcoolice sau a substantelor psihoactive.

questions.article: Regulamentul de aplicare HG 1391/2006 — prioritatea de dreapta

explanation.en: At an unsigned, uncontrolled intersection the vehicle coming from your right goes first.
explanation.ro: In intersectia nedirijata si nesemnalizata, prioritate au vehiculele care vin din dreapta.

stem.en: Two cars reach an unsigned intersection at the same time. Who goes first?
stem.ro: Doua autoturisme ajung simultan intr-o intersectie nesemnalizata. Cine trece primul?

questions.article: OUG 195/2002 — obligatia acordarii prioritatii pietonilor

explanation.en: Drivers must give way to pedestrians already on or stepping onto a marked crossing.
explanation.ro: Conducatorul este obligat sa acorde prioritate pietonilor aflati pe trecere sau care se angajeaza in traversare.

ro.a: Opreste si ii lasa sa traverseze

stem.en: A pedestrian steps onto a marked crossing. What do you do?
stem.ro: Un pieton se angajeaza in traversarea marcata. Ce faci?

questions.article: OUG 195/2002, art. 49 — limite de viteza

explanation.en: Category B limit inside built-up areas is 50 km/h unless signs say otherwise.
explanation.ro: In localitati, limita pentru categoria B este 50 km/h, daca indicatoarele nu dispun altfel.

stem.en: What is the default speed limit for cars inside a built-up area?
stem.ro: Care este viteza maxima admisa pentru autoturisme in localitati, in lipsa altor indicatoare?

questions.article: Regulamentul de aplicare HG 1391/2006 — circulatia pe autostrada

explanation.en: Motorways ban pedestrians, bicycles, mopeds and slow vehicles; minimum speed rules keep traffic flowing.
explanation.ro: Pe autostrada sunt interzisi pietonii, bicicletele, mopedele si vehiculele lente.

stem.en: Which traffic is banned from motorways? (two correct)
stem.ro: Ce categorii sunt interzise pe autostrada? (doua corecte)

questions.article: Regulamentul de aplicare HG 1391/2006 — sensul giratoriu

explanation.en: Vehicles already circulating in the roundabout have priority over entering traffic.
explanation.ro: In sensul giratoriu, prioritate au vehiculele care circula deja in interiorul acestuia.

stem.en: Who has priority at a roundabout?
stem.ro: Cine are prioritate in sensul giratoriu?

questions.article: Regulamentul de aplicare HG 1391/2006 — prioritatea tramvaielor

explanation.en: Trams running on rails have priority over road vehicles, except where signs say otherwise.
explanation.ro: Tramvaiele au prioritate fata de celelalte vehicule, cu exceptia cazurilor semnalizate altfel.

stem.en: A car and a tram cross paths at an unsigned junction. Who goes first?
stem.ro: Un autoturism si un tramvai se intalnesc intr-o intersectie nesemnalizata. Cine trece primul?

questions.article: OUG 195/2002, art. 44 — folosirea luminilor

explanation.en: Outside built-up areas, dipped headlights are compulsory during the day as well.
explanation.ro: In afara localitatilor, luminile de intalnire sunt obligatorii si pe timp de zi.

stem.en: When must you use dipped headlights outside built-up areas?
stem.ro: Cand sunt obligatorii luminile de intalnire in afara localitatilor?

questions.article: OUG 195/2002, art. 36 — centura si dispozitive de retinere

explanation.en: Seat belts are compulsory for driver and passengers; children under 135 cm need an approved child seat.
explanation.ro: Centura este obligatorie pentru sofer si pasageri; copiii sub 135 cm circula doar in scaun special omologat.

en.a: Driver and all passengers wear seat belts
en.b: Only the driver wears a seat belt
en.c: Children under 135 cm use an approved child seat

ro.a: Soferul si toti pasagerii poarta centura
ro.c: Copiii sub 135 cm folosesc scaun special omologat

stem.en: Which restraint rules apply in a car? (two correct)
stem.ro: Ce reguli de retinere se aplica intr-un autoturism? (doua corecte)

questions.article: OUG 195/2002, art. 35 — documente obligatorii

explanation.en: At a check you present licence, registration certificate and RCA insurance (plus ID).
explanation.ro: La control prezinti permisul, certificatul de inmatriculare si asigurarea RCA (plus actul de identitate).

stem.en: Which documents must you show at a traffic check? (all three correct)
stem.ro: Ce documente prezinti la controlul politiei? (toate trei corecte)

questions.article: Regulamentul de aplicare HG 1391/2006 — interzicerea depasirii

explanation.en: Overtaking is banned on pedestrian crossings, at level crossings, in unsigned intersections and where visibility is poor.

en.b: Behind a slow tractor with full visibility

ro.a: Pe un bulevard lat si drept
ro.b: In spatele unui tractor lent, cu vizibilitate totala

stem.en: Where is overtaking prohibited?
stem.ro: Unde este interzisa depasirea?

questions.article: Regulamentul de aplicare HG 1391/2006 — interzicerea opririi

explanation.en: Stopping (even briefly) is banned on marked pedestrian crossings, in intersections, on bridges and in tunnels.

stem.en: Where is even a brief stop prohibited?
stem.ro: Unde este interzisa chiar si oprirea de scurta durata?

questions.article: OUG 195/2002 — trecerea la nivel cu calea ferata

explanation.en: At flashing red or a lowering barrier you stop and wait; crossing on foot around barriers is equally banned.
explanation.ro: La semnalele rosii intermitente sau bariera in coborare opresti si astepti ridicarea barierei.

en.a: Slalom around the barrier if no train is seen
en.b: Stop and wait until the barrier rises
en.c: Turn off the engine on the tracks

ro.a: Ocoleste bariera daca nu se vede trenul

stem.en: The red lights flash at a level crossing. What do you do?
stem.ro: Luminile rosii clipesc la trecerea la nivel cu calea ferata. Ce faci?

questions.article: OUG 195/2002 — semnificatia semnalelor luminoase

stem.en: The light turns yellow as you approach. What do you do?
stem.ro: Semaforul trece pe galben in timp ce te apropii. Ce faci?

en.b: Stop unless you can no longer stop safely

ro.b: Opresti, daca nu mai poti opri in siguranta

explanation.en: Yellow means stop, unless you are so close that stopping would be unsafe.
explanation.ro: Galben inseamna oprire, cu exceptia cazului in care nu mai poti opri in siguranta.

questions.article: Regulamentul de aplicare HG 1391/2006 — sageata verde suplimentara

stem.en: Red light with an extra green arrow to the right. What may you do?
stem.ro: Semafor rosu cu sageata verde suplimentara spre dreapta. Ce poti face?

en.a: Turn right after giving way to pedestrians and traffic

ro.a: Virezi la dreapta dupa ce acorzi prioritate pietonilor si vehiculelor
ro.b: Virezi la dreapta fara nicio obligatie

explanation.en: The arrow permits the turn but priority to others remains.
explanation.ro: Sageata permite virajul, dar prioritatea celorlalti ramane.

questions.article: OUG 195/2002 — ierarhia semnalizarii

stem.en: The officer's signal contradicts the green light. Which do you obey?
stem.ro: Semnalul politistului contrazice culoarea verde a semaforului. Pe care il respecti?

explanation.en: Officer signals outrank lights, signs and markings.
explanation.ro: Semnalele politistului au prioritate fata de semafor, indicatoare si marcaje.

questions.article: Regulament aplicare OUG 195/2002, art. 88 — bratul ridicat vertical

stem.en: The officer raises one arm vertically. What does it mean?
stem.ro: Politistul ridica un brat pe verticala. Ce inseamna?

en.a: Attention, stop for all approaching traffic

ro.a: Atentie, oprire pentru toti participantii care se apropie
ro.b: Toata lumea poate trece mai repede

explanation.en: Raised arm means attention and stop, except drivers who can no longer stop safely (and vehicles already crossing the intersection).
explanation.ro: Bratul ridicat inseamna atentie si oprire, cu exceptia celor care nu mai pot opri in siguranta (si a celor deja angajati in traversarea intersectiei).

questions.article: Regulament aplicare OUG 195/2002, art. 88 — bratele intinse orizontal

stem.en: The officer holds both arms out horizontally. Who must stop?
stem.ro: Politistul tine ambele brate intinse orizontal. Cine trebuie sa opreasca?

en.b: Traffic coming from the directions the arms point across (front and back)

ro.b: Cei care vin din directiile intersectate de brate (fata si spate)

explanation.en: Outstretched arms stop traffic from the directions they cut across; side traffic may pass.
explanation.ro: Bratele intinse opresc circulatia din directiile intersectate; cei din lateral pot trece.

questions.article: Regulament aplicare OUG 195/2002, art. 88 — pozitia corpului

stem.en: After lowering his arms the officer just stands facing you. What does his position mean?
stem.ro: Dupa ce coboara bratele, politistul ramane pur si simplu cu fata spre tine. Ce inseamna pozitia sa?

en.b: Stop: his body still means stop for front and back traffic

ro.b: Oprire: pozitia corpului inseamna in continuare oprire pentru cei din fata si spate

explanation.en: Even with arms down, facing (or back to) traffic means stop for those directions.
explanation.ro: Chiar si cu bratele coborate, pozitia cu fata sau spatele spre tine inseamna oprire.

questions.article: OUG 195/2002 — semnalizarea schimbarii directiei

stem.en: When must you signal a lane change or turn?
stem.ro: Cand trebuie sa semnalizezi schimbarea benzii sau a directiei?

en.c: Only when another car is behind

ro.c: Doar cand e o masina in spate

explanation.en: Signalling is compulsory before every direction or lane change.
explanation.ro: Semnalizarea este obligatorie inaintea oricarei schimbari de directie sau de banda.

questions.article: Regulamentul de aplicare HG 1391/2006 — semnale cu bratul

stem.en: How does a cyclist signal a left turn?
stem.ro: Cum semnalizeaza un biciclist virajul la stanga?

en.b: With the left arm extended horizontally

explanation.en: Vehicles without indicators (bicycles) signal with the arm on the turning side.
explanation.ro: Vehiculele fara semnalizare (bicicletele) semnalizeaza cu bratul de pe partea virajului.

questions.article: OUG 195/2002 — luminile de avarie

stem.en: When must you switch on the hazard lights?
stem.ro: Cand trebuie sa pui luminile de avarie?

en.a: When parked illegally for a minute
en.b: When your vehicle breaks down or you must stop suddenly on the road

ro.b: Cand ramai in pana sau opresti fortat pe carosabil

explanation.en: Hazards warn others of a breakdown or forced stop, plus the warning triangle.
explanation.ro: Avarile avertizeaza asupra penei sau opririi fortate, impreuna cu triunghiul presemnalizator.

questions.article: Regulamentul de aplicare HG 1391/2006 — interzicerea intoarcerii

stem.en: Where is a U-turn prohibited?
stem.ro: Unde este interzisa intoarcerea?

en.b: In a large empty parking lot

ro.c: Pe o strada lata cu sens unic

explanation.en: U-turns are banned on crossings, bridges, tunnels, level crossings and where visibility is poor.
explanation.ro: Intoarcerea e interzisa pe treceri, poduri, tuneluri, la calea ferata si unde vizibilitatea e redusa.

questions.article: Regulamentul de aplicare HG 1391/2006 — mersul inapoi

stem.en: You must reverse a short distance. What is compulsory?
stem.ro: Trebuie sa mergi putin cu spatele. Ce este obligatoriu?

en.b: Make sure the manoeuvre endangers or hinders nobody

ro.b: Sa te asiguri ca nu pui in pericol si nu stinjenesti pe nimeni

explanation.en: Reversing is allowed only with full reassurance and without hindering others; never on motorways.
explanation.ro: Mersul inapoi e permis doar cu asigurare completa, fara a-i stinjeni pe ceilalti; niciodata pe autostrada.

questions.article: Regulamentul de aplicare HG 1391/2006 — locuri interzise

stem.en: Reversing is prohibited in which places? (two correct)
stem.ro: Mersul inapoi este interzis in ce locuri? (doua corecte)

explanation.en: No reversing on motorways or in intersections; elsewhere only briefly and safely.
explanation.ro: Fara mers inapoi pe autostrada sau in intersectii; in rest doar scurt si in siguranta.
